report: MRI ΑΡΙΣΤΕΡΟΥ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε µε ακολουθίες παλµών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων µε καταστολή του σήµατος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθµιδωτής ηχούς. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Στο έσω διαµέρισµα παρατηρείται απλή εκφύλιση του µηνίσκου χωρίς ρήξη αυτού. Επίσης παρατηρείται επιχείλιο οστεόφυτο στον έσω µηριαίο κόνδυλο καθώς και το πιθανότερο τραυµατικής αρχής µικρό έλλειµµα του αρθρικού χόνδρου. Από τον έλεγχο του έξω διαµερίσµατος παρατηρούνται επίσης επιχείλια οστεόφυτα καθώς και εκφύλιση του έξω µηνίσκου χωρίς ευρήµατα ρήξης αυτού. Ο αρθρικός χόνδρος παρουσιάζει στον άξονα φόρτισης εστιακό έλλειµµα προσθιοπίσθιας διαµέτρου 6mm και στην πρόσθια µοίρα του έξω µηριαίου κονδύλου σε έκταση 2cm περίπου ολική διάβρωση του αρθρικού χόνδρου (ICRS grade 4) µε υπαρθρικό οστεοµυελικό οίδηµα. Από τον έλεγχο του πρόσθιου διαµερίσµατος παρατηρείται ολική διάβρωση του αρθρικού χόνδρου της έξω άνω αρθρικής επιφάνειας της επιγονατίδας (ICRS grade 4) µε υπαρθρικές αλλοιώσεις του οστικού µυελού. Ενδαρθρικά παρατηρείται ευµεγέθη συλλογή υγρού µε κατά τόπους προσεκβολή σύστασης λιπώδους ιστού ενώ επιπλέον παρατηρείται και ευµεγέθης υµενική πτυχή τόσο στην έσω όσο και στην έξω υπερεπιγονατιδική µοίρα. Συνοβιακή κύστη Baker παρατηρείται στην ιγνυακή κοιλότητα µε ευρήµατα µικρορήξεων του τοιχώµατος αυτής .Παρεµπιπτόντως ενδαρθρικά όπισθεν του έσω µηριαίου επικονδύλου παρατηρείται οστεοχόνδρινο ξένο σώµα µέγιστης διαµέτρου 6mm. Συµπέρασµα: 1. Εκφυλιστική οστεοαρθρίτιδα έξω διαµερίσµατος. 2. Εκφυλιστική οστεοαρθρίτιδα επιγονατιδοµηριαίας συµβολής κατά την ανώτερη µοίρα αυτής. 3. Υδραρθρο µε παρουσία δευτεροπαθούς φυλλόµορφου λιπώµατος (lipoma arborescens) εντός αυτής καθώς επίσης και µικρού ξένου σώµατος.

Erhaltene Artikulation im linken Kniegelenk. Bekannter Patella alta (Insall-Salvati 1,85) sowie unverändert lateralisiert stehende Patella. Im Verlauf progredienter vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt am Patellafirst und der lateralen Facette am unteren Patellapol über ca. 1,5 x 1,0 cm. Angrenzendes intraossäres Reizödem (4/7). Auch an der lateralen Femurfacette teils vollschichtige Chondropathie (7/14). Einzelnes Ossikel im MPFL (7/10). Jedoch kein Hinweis auf eine Diskontinuität des Ligaments.
Femorotibial erhaltener Artikulation. Osteophytäre Anbauten führend am lateralen Femurkondylus (4/18) sowie am lateralen Tibiaplateau (4/19), kleinere Osteophyten auch am medialen Kompartiment sowie femoropatellar.
Lateral femorotibial abschnittsweise ausgedünnter Knorpelbelag, exemplarisch anterioren der Femurkondyle (5/23). Im medialen Kompartiment nach weitestgehend erhaltener Knorpelbelag. Menisci intakt ohne Hinweis auf eine Rissbildung. Das Innenmeniskushinterhorn gering signalangehoben in der PD, DD bei initialen mukoiden Veränderungen. Kreuzbänder ebenfalls intakt. Schmaler Flüssigkeitssaum medial des MCL, DD bei Reizzustand, kein Hinweis auf eine Ruptur. LCL unauffällig.
Geringer Gelenkerguss. Synovia gering verdickt, zu 06/12 minimal progrediente Baker-Zyste (3/97). Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und Subkutis.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Chondral thinning along the lateral patellar facet with superimposed foci of high-grade fissuring. Broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss along the lateral trochlea with subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal patellar tendinosis.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Intense soft tissue edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

Findings of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with Hoffa's fat pad impingement, mild proximal patellar tendinosis, and grade 4 patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
No significant joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Moderate to severe degeneration. Diffuse partial thickness chondral loss with full-thickness chondral loss of the weightbearing portion of the compartment. Minimal associated subchondral reactive marrow change. Marginal osteophytes.
Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the meniscus with a dominant radial component involving the posterior root horn junction. Associated meniscal substance loss. Early flap tear with mild displacement into the tibial gutter. Mild extrusion of the body.
Medial collateral imaging is intact.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Moderate to severe degeneration.
Diffuse high-grade partial-thickness chondral loss with no full-thickness component. Marginal osteophytosis.
Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the meniscus with a horizontal oblique longitudinal components and meniscal substance loss. Mild meniscal extrusion.
The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
The ACL and PCL are intact.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Moderate to severe degeneration.
Full thickness chondral loss of the inferior aspect of the lateral and medial facets with subchondral reactive marrow change, full-thickness chondral loss of the lateral facet of the trochlea, and diffuse high-grade partial thickness chondral loss of the medial facet.
Marginal osteophytosis. Mild edema of the suprapatellar fat pad.

Bones:
See above.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
Small ganglion cyst seen posterior to the PCL measuring up to 7 mm.

CONCLUSION:
1.Moderate to severe tricompartmental degenerative disease.
2.Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with a dominant radial component involving the posterior root horn junction. Associated meniscal substance loss. Early flap tear with mild displacement into the tibial gutter.
3.Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus with a horizontal oblique longitudinal components and meniscal substance loss. Mild meniscal extrusion.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left posterior knee pain for 7 months.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis, most pronounced at the posterior medial femoral condyle. Osteophytes protruding into the intercondylar notch.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. 5 mm intra-articular body at the intercondylar notch. Trace leaking Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tearing with dominant near-complete radial tear of the posterior horn. Severe meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Large areas of full-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint and extending to the posterior femoral condyle with associated subchondral signal changes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade articular cartilage loss at the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle near the intercondylar eminence with button osteophyte formation.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Large confluent regions of full-thickness articular cartilage loss at the patella and lateral trochlea with associated subchondral signal changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Severe mucoid degeneration.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 14 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Nonspecific retro-quadriceps fat pad edema.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Medial tibiofemoral compartment and patellofemoral osteoarthritis. Small knee joint effusion with 5 mm intra-articular body at the intercondylar notch.
2.	Complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with dominant radial tear at the posterior horn and severe meniscal extrusion.
3.	Severe mucoid degeneration of the ACL.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Right-sided knee pain.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Diminutive posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus, consistent with extensive complex tearing. The anterior horn shows intrasubstance degeneration without tear. The posterior root is barely perceptible consistent with extensive complex tear. There is peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body.

Barely perceptible posterior root of the lateral meniscus raising suspicion for complex tear of the posterior root of the lateral meniscus. No lateral meniscal extrusion. 

Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with intrasubstance ganglion formation. Slight anterior tibial translation.

Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the superficial fibers of the medial collateral ligament near the medial femoral condyle origin. The meniscotibial meniscal femoral component of the deep medial collateral ligament are intact. The posterior oblique ligament is intact.

Fibular collateral ligament is intact. Moderate popliteus tendinosis of the lateral femoral condylar attachment, without tear. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. The iliotibial band is intact.

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 15 mm, at the upper limit of normal. No patellofemoral subluxation.

There is focal full thickness cartilage denuding at the patellar apex with fissuring of articular cartilage at the patellar apex and extending along the medial patellar facet. There is diffuse full-thickness cartilage denuding throughout the weightbearing aspect of the medial femorotibial compartment with subchondral sclerosis. There is mild to moderate lateral femorotibial chondrosis. Prominent non-marginal lateral femoral condylar osteophyte.

Trace knee joint fluid. Subcutaneous edema along the lateral and posterior aspects of the knee and proximal calf. There is generalized atrophy of the regional musculature which maybe on the basis of deconditioning. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Extensive complex tear involving the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with medial meniscal extrusion and tricompartment chondrosis as pronounced along the medial femorotibial compartment, consistent with severe medial compartment predominant tricompartment osteoarthritis of the right knee.
2. Suspected complex tear of the posterior root of the lateral meniscus without lateral meniscal extrusion.
3. Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the superficial fibers of the medial collateral ligament. Components of the deep medial collateral ligament are intact.
4. Popliteus tendinosis without tear.
5. Borderline lateralization of the tibial tubercle which may predispose to patellofemoral maltracking/instability. No patellofemoral subluxation.
6. Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with slight anterior tibial translation.

Erhaltene Artikulation im linken Knie. Deutliche T2 Signalanhebungen intraossär in der medialen Femurkondyle sowie etwas geringer auch subchondral im medialen Tibiaplateau. Ansonsten unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Geringe oberflächliche Chondropathie retropatellar (z.B. 7/11). Vollschichtig, flächige Chondropathie im medialen femorotibialen Kompartiment (z. B. 4/17). In der medialen Femurkondyle kleinzystische Veränderungen (4/17). Im lateralen femorotibialen Kompartiment keine wesentliche Chondropathie. Außenmeniskushinterhorn geringe signalalteriert. Kein Nachweis einer Rissbildung. Der Innenmeniskus ausgeprägt mukoide T2 signalalteriert und aufgefasert mit Extrusion in der Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn bei komplexer Rissbildung mit unter anderem vollständiger radiärer Komponente nahe der Hinterhornwurzel (z. B. 3/98). Kleine parameniskale Zysten (z. B. 4/22). Kreuzbänder und Kollateralbänder intakt. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Synovia verdickt und unscharf, DD bei Reiz Synovialitis. Umgebende Muskulatur und Subkutis unauffällig.

Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Chronic full thickness tear

Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:

1. Severe tricompartmental knee osteoarthritis.

2. Complex macerated tears of the medial and lateral menisci.

3. Chronic full-thickness tears of the ACL and PCL.
